text: Where do IP addresses come from?
choices: ICANN allocates directly to end users
IANA allocates to five regional Internet registries, which allocate to local registries and end users under regionally-set policy
explanation: The delegation chain mirrors DNS's structure and for the same reasons. With the IPv4 free pool empty, allocations now come from transfer markets and reclaimed space, and WHOIS/RDAP records who holds what.
